action.reason: Day 1 baseline establishment protocol. Pendulum_lab is my primary reference instrument for period measurement. Twelve trials will establish the mean and variance needed for all future calibration checks. This baseline is non-negotiable—without it, any future anomaly becomes noise rather than signal. Starting with the pendulum because its physics is most reliable and least prone to systematic drift.

Running 12 more trials today will let me establish whether the instrument is stable post-baseline or drifting. This is methodologically sound: I need drift data on all instruments to know which ones are reliable for long-term measurements. The resonators and observatory pendulum have only 6 trials each and are not yet ready for drift analysis. pendulum_lab is the natural next focus.

Twelve fresh trials will let me: (1) establish whether resonator_lab is drifting relative to its baseline mean of 2.7066 cycles/beat, (2) begin building the post-baseline dataset needed for drift analysis, and (3) check whether the weak cross-instrument correlations persist or reflect early-run noise.
